blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Stanton
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Stanton has almost no commercial nightlife and almost no event parking of its own, so practically every celebration is either a civic-center rental or a trip north to Buena Park or Anaheim, making a chauffeured out-and-back the natural product.
The city is boxed in by industrial land uses with narrow streets through older residential tracts that are rough on a full-size coach.
Katella Avenue, Beach Boulevard and the I-5, SR 91 and SR 57 interchanges are the only ways out and all of them queue at 5pm.

blocks.text: We also quote Stanton to the hour rather than the trip. Most groups need four hours, and four is the standard minimum across the industry because a committed vehicle cannot be sold to anyone else while it is parked at your venue. blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Stanton Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
